title: Day 2: an AI turned push-ups into a rhythm game #shorts
description:
Push-ups, but it's a rhythm game.

Push Beat is today's app in our series "AI ships an app a day": every day an AI builds a brand-new iPhone app from scratch, and we show you what it made.

Put your iPhone on the floor and touch it with your nose (or chin) on every beat. Hit it on time for a Perfect. No counting: when the song ends, today's set is done.

- A 30-day path that adapts to your reps
- 8 push-up styles, from knee push-ups to pike
- Endless mode to chase your best

Push Beat - coming soon to the App Store

The music in this video is made from scratch for this channel. Narration is a synthetic voice reading our own script.

Follow for Day 3 tomorrow.

#pushups #homeworkout #fitness #rhythmgame #indiegame
